profitSharing.title: Partners and profit sharing
profitSharing.subtitle: Each company has its own partners and share % · incentives agreed in the minutes are taken from net profit first · Admin only
profitSharing.noView: Partners and profit sharing need the partners right. Ask Admin.
profitSharing.none: No partner recorded for this company yet.
profitSharing.partnersNote: Legal partners hold the shares on the register; investment partners have money on the investment sheet. One person can be both. Share % must add up to 100 before profit can be shared.

form.hint: Shares and share % come from the share register and the signed minutes; the server refuses a total above 100 %. Accounts are the partner's ledgers in this company's books.
form.name: Name
form.portalHelp: The person must hold the investor role for this company (Users & rights).
form.director_interested: A director is interested in this partner (s.185)

min.title: How the profit is shared · by the signed minutes
min.addHint: Enter the meeting date, the minutes reference and each incentive as a % of net profit. Another Admin approves the minutes before profit is shared.

inv.title: Investments recorded
inv.hint: A memo of money a partner put in; the CA restates the capital accounts at cut-over. A project investment needs the project and the signed agreement.

proj.title: Projects
proj.name: Project
proj.visibleHint: Partners of this company see the name, status and summary in their portal.

law.title: In a private limited company
law.one: Profit reaches shareholders as dividend, in proportion to the shares they hold. A ratio different from the shareholding needs the shares held in that ratio or a separate class of shares.
law.two: Incentives are paid as remuneration to the partners who do that work, before the profit for shareholders is worked out.
law.three: Set the ratios with your CA or company secretary before the first payout.

sees.title: What each partner sees
sees.one: The investor portal is a separate app with its own sign-in. Partners see the companies they share in: money in, shareholding and their requests.
sees.two: Analytics only: no buyer names, invoices or documents. Figures exclude bills without GST unless Admin records that policy.
